entries.title: Jump Mechanics — Breath of the Wild Research
entries.summary: Confirmed BotW frame data at 30fps. Coyote time 6-8f, buffer 6f, fall multiplier 2.0-2.5x, asymmetric arc. All features we considered removing are present — tuning was wrong, mechanics were right.

entries.title: Parkour Momentum Mechanics — Research
entries.summary: Three momentum patterns: carry-over, building, and as resource. Game-by-game breakdown with parameter ranges. Landing is the critical moment where planted vs. carry-over shows.

entries.title: Tachyon Flow (JankyAnims) — Character Controller Reference
entries.summary: Detailed breakdown of Tachyon Flow's controller — target feel reference for this project. Smoothness is 90% animation, not code. Key: lerp-to-zero on stop, forward speed carry-over on jump, momentum build-up.

entries.title: Jump System — Current State
entries.summary: Current JumpSettings values, how the controller uses them, known issues list, full tuning history. Living document — updated as the system evolves.
